explanation: Body rebounds off left arena wall at ~46 m/s and grazes the left end/corner of the thin horizontal wall (thickness 0.275). Discrete impulse plus positional correction fails to resolve the fast corner contact in time: separated by 0.11 at step 28, embedded by 0.254 at step 29. Lowering horizontal speed removes the failure, confirming speed-dependent contact-resolution penetration, not tunneling through the slab.
